title: Live Art Dance

services.name: Buy Tickets
services.desc: Our 2026-2027 season may be smaller than usual but small is mighty! We have three terrific shows - one local, one national, and one international - coming together to create a vibrant voyage through the world of contemporary dance. Don’t miss out get your tickets today. At Live Art Dance our wish is to deliver an extraordinary dance experience! Your feedback is always welcome. Live Art Dance is grateful to be working in Kjipuktuk, on the ancestral and unceded territory of the Mi'kmaq people. We are grateful to be on this land, and have deep respect for those who have been its caretakers for millenia. We are committed to working to understand and live by the Treaties of Peace and Friendship
